title: Punjab Agricultural University Museum, Ludhiana
content:
A Glimpse into Punjab’s Rich Agricultural and Rural Heritage

Punjab Agricultural University Museum, located inside the lush green PAU campus in Ludhiana, is a unique cultural and educational attraction that beautifully preserves the rural heritage and agricultural history of Punjab. The museum offers visitors a deep insight into traditional Punjabi village life, farming practices, folk culture, and the legacy of agriculture that shaped the state.

History of Punjab Agricultural University Museum

Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) was established in 1962 and played a major role during the Green Revolution in India. The museum was created to preserve and display traditional agricultural tools, rural household items, and cultural artifacts that were slowly disappearing due to modernization.

Architecture & Layout

The museum is designed to resemble a traditional Punjabi village setup.
Its structure includes:

  • Mud-style walls and courtyards
  • Traditional engraved wooden doors
  • Open spaces that reflect village homes

What to See Inside the Museum

1. Rural Life Gallery

  • Traditional chulhas (mud stoves)
  • Hand-woven cots (charpai)
  • Grain storage baskets
  • Earthen pots and bronze utensils

2. Agricultural Tools & Equipment

  • Old farming implements
  • Water-lifting devices used in villages
  • Traditional ploughs and harvesting tools

3. Cultural & Folk Artifacts

  • Phulkari embroidery
  • Punjabi juttis
  • Folk musical instruments like dhol, algoza, and sarangi
  • Mannequins depicting village occupations

4. Specialised Museums at PAU

  • PAU campus also houses specialised museums related to:
  • Green Revolution
  • Soil science
  • Insects and pests
  • Land and water resources

Timings of Punjab Agricultural University Museum

Opening Time: 9:00 AM
Closing Time: 5:00 PM
Lunch Break: 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM
Closed On: Sundays & public holidays

(Timings may vary on special occasions)

 Best Time to Visit

The best time to visit the museum is from October to March, when the weather is pleasant. Morning hours are ideal to explore the exhibits comfortably.

Nearby Places to Visit

  • Rakh Bagh Park
  • PAU Botanical Garden
  • Nehru Rose Garden
  • Lodhi Fort
